import pandas as pd

def clean(df):
    # Remove exact duplicate rows (keep first occurrence)
    df = df.drop_duplicates()
    # Trim extra spaces in island labels and standardize
    df['island'] = df['island'].str.strip()
    # Convert body_mass_g to numeric, coercing errors to NaN, then filter out-of-range values
    df['body_mass_g'] = pd.to_numeric(df['body_mass_g'].str.replace(',', ''), errors='coerce')
    df = df[(df['body_mass_g'] >= 2500) & (df['body_mass_g'] <= 6500)]
    # Convert flipper_length_mm to numeric (already numeric but ensure type) and filter out-of-range
    df['flipper_length_mm'] = pd.to_numeric(df['flipper_length_mm'])
    df = df[(df['flipper_length_mm'] >= 170) & (df['flipper_length_mm'] <= 235)]
    # Keep the id column as required
    return df

def answer(df):
    # Group by sex and compute average body mass
    result = df.groupby('sex')['body_mass_g'].mean().to_dict()
    return result
